disputable.why: Lilting Lullaby only affects enemies who carry Dream Dust, though it reaches them anywhere on the map. Players who think of 'global' as range will argue it's a conditional effect.
Golden Eclipse only hits enemies marked with Overwhelm, though regardless of distance. Same argument as Lillia.
Paranoia's darkness and vision are map-wide but the dash is limited range. Most players accept it as a global ult.
Destiny reveals all enemy champions map-wide but the teleport is limited range. Most players still count it.

fun.why: A classic question everyone can answer. With 13 answers there's a clear core (Karthus, Jinx, Ashe, Ezreal, Shen, Soraka) and a tail most players miss (Nocturne, Lillia, Mel).

champion:Karthus.why: Requiem is the textbook global ult and the one players name first.

champion:Jinx.why: The rocket across the map is iconic; most ADC players name it first.

champion:Shen.why: Stand United is the go-to example for a global support ult.

champion:Soraka.why: Wish is widely known as the global heal.

champion:TwistedFate.why: Destiny is famous for map-wide plays, though its travel is limited.

champion:Gangplank.why: Cannon Barrage anywhere on the map is well known among top-lane and veteran players.

champion:Senna.why: The global beam is well known to bot-lane players but rarely comes to mind first.

champion:Nocturne.why: Players remember Paranoia's darkness but often think of the limited-range dash first.

champion:Lillia.why: Few players know her ult hits Drowsy targets anywhere on the map.

champion:Mel.why: A newer champion; few players know Golden Eclipse is distance-independent.

champion:Ashe.why: The cross-map arrow is one of the first global ults players think of.

champion:Ezreal.why: Trueshot Barrage across the map is iconic, and Ezreal is one of the most played champions.

champion:Draven.why: Players know the axes fly forever but rarely think of it first.

gemCandidates.why: A satisfying reveal for players who know her: the map-wide sleep. Rarer than Nocturne but still reached by some.
The 'oh, of course, the lights go out!' answer. Plenty of players get it, and it's the one people kick themselves for forgetting.
A real global beam that bot-lane players know; it surprises everyone else.
